goal: Test whether the CertaIndex probe prompt improves the accuracy-output-token trade-off by delaying the first answer consensus relative to Simple@32.

design.type: prompt-timing ablation (NOT a comparison of stopping rules)
shared: probe every 64 main tokens starting at token 64
temperature/top_p/seed inherited from the frozen main run (base_seed)
stop on the first window of 3 consecutive probes whose answers are non-empty, mathematically equivalent, and certain (CertaIndex mid patience=3 rule)

certaindex.suffix: CERTAINDEX_SUFFIX = '... Oh, I suddenly got the answer to the whole problem, **Final Answer**\n\n\\[ \\boxed{'
certaindex.online_stop: the CertaIndex collector may stop issuing future probes once its first eligible three-probe consensus is observed (online cost optimization; preserves the first-consensus estimand)

frozen_scope.note: different seed sets reflect the already-collected train/dev and test banks; every benchmark problem has three sampled trajectories. The report pools all 3420 rows and includes no train/dev/test table.

probe_settings.probe_seed_policy: base_seed (prompt-matched to the frozen main run)

cost_accounting.primary: main tokens through stop + consumed probe output tokens (generated output tokens only)
cost_accounting.separately_reported: probe prompt/prefill tokens and wall time (never called total GPU compute or latency)
